character: A woman in her mid-thirties, narrow-faced, still and composed. Dark hair pinned back tight and flat. Ink stains on the fingers, three quills tucked behind one ear. A small courteous smile, the eyes flat and steady above it
wardrobe: a navy uniform coat with gold piping and a high collar, sleeves buttoned to the wrist, a brass badge pinned exactly level on the chest, a fine silver chain at one wrist, every line pressed sharp

full.framing: Full body standing portrait, front view, standing straight with hands clasped in front of her, plain neutral background.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer directly, chin slightly lifted.

scene.framing: A receptionist standing behind a tall wooden desk in the lamplit front room of a guild hall, a cork board of pinned notices on the wall behind her, one hand flat on an open ledger, looking up at the viewer.
